Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface ApiKeyPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
ApiKeyAdapter
public interface ApiKeyPort
Outbound port for API key persistence operations.

Adapters implementing this port handle storage and retrieval of API keys. Key lookup by hash is the primary authentication path — the raw key is never stored.
